tha-ap16:1.1: samattaṃ. [14. Culla-Panthaka.] Padumuttaro nāma jino āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho / gaṇamhā vupakaṭṭho so Himavante vasī tadā. // //
tha-ap16:2.1: Aham pi Himavantamhi vasāmi assame tadā / acirāgataṃ mahāvīraṃ upesiṃ lokanāyakaṃ. // //
tha-ap16:3.1: Pupphacchattaṃ gahetvāna upagañchiṃ narāsabhaṃ / samādhiṃ samāpajjantaṃ antarāyam akās' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap16:4.1: Ubho hatthehi paggayha pupphachattaṃ adās' ahaṃ / paṭiggahesi bhagavā Padumuttaro mahāmuni. // //
tha-ap16:5.1: Sabbe devā attamanā Himavantam upenti te / sādhukāraṃ pavattiṃsu: ‘anumodissati cakkhumā.' // //
tha-ap16:6.1: Idaṃ vatvāna te devā upagañchuṃ naruttamaṃ / ākāse dhārayant' assa padumacchattam uttamaṃ // //
tha-ap16:7.1: Padumachattaṃ paggayha adāsi tāpaso mamaṃ / ‘tam ahaṃ kittayissāmi; suṇotha mama bhāsato: // //
tha-ap16:8.1: Pañcavīsatikappāni devarajjaṃ karissati / catuttiṃsatikkhattuñ ca cakkavatti bhavissati. // //
tha-ap16:9.1: Yaṃ yaṃ yoniṃ saṃsarati devattaṃ atha mānusaṃ / abbhokāse patiṭṭhan taṃ padumaṃ dhārayissati. // //
tha-ap16:10.1: Kappasatasahassamhi Okkākakulasambhavo / Gotamo nāma nāmena satthā loke bhavissati. // //
tha-ap16:11.1: Pakāsite pāvacane manussattaṃ labhissati / manomayamhi kāyamhi uttamo so bhavissati. // //
tha-ap16:12.1: Dve bhātaro bhavissanti ubho pi Panthasavhayā / anubhotvā uttamatthaṃ jotayissanti sāsanan.' // //
tha-ap16:13.1: Aṭṭhārasañ ca vasso 'haṃ pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ / visesāhaṃ na vindāmi Sakyaputtassa sāsane. // //
tha-ap16:14.1: Dandhā mayhaṃ gati āsi paribhūto *pure ahaṃ / bhā*tā ca maṃ paṇāmesi: ‘gaccha dāni sakaṃ gharaṃ.' // //
tha-ap16:15.1: So 'haṃ paṇāmito santo saṅghārāmassa koṭṭhake / dummano tattha aṭṭhāsiṃ sāmaññasmiṃ apekhavā. // //
tha-ap16:16.1: Ath' ettha satthā āgañchi sīsaṃ mayhaṃ parāmasi / bāhāya maṃ gahetvāna *saṅghārāmaṃ pavesayi.* // //
tha-ap16:17.1: Anukampāya me satthā adāsī pādapuñchaniṃ / evaṃ suddhaṃ adhiṭṭhehi ekamantam adhiṭṭhitaṃ. // //
tha-ap16:18.1: Hatthehi tam ahaṃ gayha sariṃ kokanadaṃ ahaṃ / tattha cittaṃ vimuccī me arahattaṃ apāpuniṃ. // //
tha-ap16:19.1: Manomayesu kāyesu sabbattha pāramiṅga*to / sabbāsave pariññā*ya viharāmi anāsavo. // //
tha-ap16:20.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap16:21.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Cullapanthakothero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti.
